_comment: Velpari bundled custom-roles starter. The first example role is `pseudocode-reviewer` — a sub-agent that validates the published pseudocode against the tier rubric. `/velpari-generate-sub-agents --custom` on a fresh project copies this file into `.pi/velpari/custom-roles.json` and emits the agent file. Edit `.pi/velpari/custom-roles.json` to add more custom roles or to customize this one.

roles.label: Pseudocode — tier-compliance reviewer
roles.mandate: Read the published pseudocode_<projectName>.md and verify it follows the tier rubric in the ## Tier rubric section of the pseudocode reviewer agent definition (pseudocode-reviewer-body.md). Check that every function block carries a tier stamp, that required fields per tier are present, and that PRECONDITIONS / POSTCONDITIONS / Edge Cases / Errors / Complexity / Dependencies / Side effects are well-formed. Emit a structured JSON review report to the assigned artifact path.
roles.invocationHint: Spawn at /velpari-approve for the pseudocode stage, after the 4 scouts (algorithm-extractor, edge-case-handler, complexity-analyzer, consolidator) have written the working copy. Runs as a post-reviewer before the user-facing preview gate. Read-only on the pseudocode artifact.
outOfScope: Do not edit the pseudocode artifact or any other artifact (read-only).
Do not write or create source files.
Do not call other subagents (you are a leaf specialist).
Do not advance the run state or trigger publish — the parent LLM maps your JSON verdict to the publish decision.
Do not enforce rules that are not in the canonical check list — emit an advisory note instead.
